facts.business: Mphasis Limited is an IT services company delivering AI-powered enterprise solutions through platforms like Mphasis Tria and Mphasis NeoIP, offering application modernization (Mphasis Modernize) and decision optimization (Mphasis Optimize) services.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: Evaluation of tax positions (Notes 23 and 31(a)) and Impairment testing of Goodwill (Note 5)

key_risks: Increasing cybersecurity risks due to rapid adoption of AI technologies including phishing, ransomware, and deepfake manipulation
Poor data and systems management harming reputation and stakeholder confidence
Tax litigation and transfer pricing challenges with significant estimation uncertainty
Goodwill impairment risk given significant balance on consolidated balance sheet
